title: MONTE Standard — Barbell Bench Press

checks.text: Free-weight flat bench; head, shoulders and buttocks remain on bench; feet supported and fixed. Use a full thumb-around grip. Record belt/wrist wraps; no bench shirt or assistance device.
Lower to chest or upper abdomen under control. The bar must visibly stop before pressing; no bounce or heave. Side-oblique view must show contact and elbows.
At the bottom, the underside of both elbow joints reaches at least the top surface of each shoulder joint. Camera must permit judgment; ambiguous footage is inconclusive.
Press to stable extension of both elbows without downward reversal; rack only after completion. Handoff allowed before the start, but any spotter contact during the scored rep invalidates it.

safety: Do not attempt a dangerous maximum for a rank. Use conservative loads, appropriate safety equipment and competent spotting. Pain or an unclear camera angle is not a reason to repeat a dangerous lift. Ranking is optional.
evidence: Continuous unedited footage showing setup, complete attempt and finish; load markings and total load, date/identity linkage and bodyweight/category attestation must be reviewable. Additional angles may be required. No automated form or identity certification.
visualExamples: Pending qualified review; no fabricated example footage is supplied.
